planets.name: K2-286 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-286 with a 27.4-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-286 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-286. Its orbit and size follow Díez Alonso et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
